comments.body:
I study electrical and electronic engineering. From a very young age it was the aforementioned, biology and hydraulic civil engineering that i have always had a burning passion for. These days I also love politics and neuroscientific philosophy and my passion in engineering has a convenient transferable skill where I can use Logic gates as an analogy to explain how networks of neurones make up what we perceive as consciousness, I use it during religious debates. 

I was born to someone with learning difficulties, I have Foetal Alcohol Spectrum, was misdiagnosed with autism and was taken out of school by my family just before year 8. I don’t know my IQ and frankly want to avoid being tested but I think this highlights how stereotypes are not always true, just like this graph is an okay ball park way at determining average IQs through occupations but it’s not perfect. Even if the IQ tests are accurate within five points, the concept of IQ is flawed. 

Those who scored a certain iq scored that because of their performance in the nature tasks they were presented with on the day.
comments.author: BiscottiGreat6698
